title: Unsafe water in small towns
body: Many small towns store drinking water in overhead tanks that are checked rarely. Contamination is found only after people fall ill.

title: Hostel food waste
body: College hostels throw away a large share of the food they cook every day because demand is hard to predict.

title: E-waste in student rooms
body: Old phones, chargers and laptops pile up in hostels and homes with no easy, trusted way to recycle them.

title: Plastic at campus events
body: Fests and events produce bags of single-use plastic cups and plates that end up in open dumps.

title: Air quality near schools
body: Parents near busy roads have no way to know when the air outside their child's school is unsafe.

title: Leaking taps and pipes
body: Housing societies lose water to leaks they only discover when the monthly bill or a shortage arrives.

title: Campus parking
body: Students and staff circle the campus for parking every morning while some lots sit half empty.

title: Last-mile from the metro
body: Commuters spend as long getting from the metro station to their office as on the train itself.

title: Late-night travel safety
body: Students returning late from internships or events feel unsafe on shared autos and empty roads.

title: Two-wheeler breakdowns
body: Riders who break down on highways wait hours for a trusted mechanic and are often overcharged.

title: Bus timings in small cities
body: State buses in small cities have no live tracking, so passengers wait at stops without knowing when a bus will come.

title: Cycle theft on campus
body: Students stop cycling to class because bicycles are stolen from open stands.

title: Medicine reminders for the elderly
body: Elderly people living alone miss doses of daily medicines, and their children in other cities cannot check.

title: Clinic queues
body: Patients at small clinics wait hours in crowded rooms without knowing when they will be seen.

title: Student mental health
body: Students under exam pressure do not seek help because counselling feels formal, slow and visible to others.

title: Blood donor matching
body: Hospitals in emergencies phone long lists of donors because there is no live view of who can donate.

title: Fitness for desk workers
body: Office workers sit for ten hours a day and give up on gym plans within a month.

title: Rural pharmacy stock-outs
body: Village pharmacies run out of common medicines and patients travel to the town to buy them.

title: Board exam revision
body: School students in small towns cannot afford coaching and revise from scattered, outdated material.

title: Library seat booking
body: College libraries are full during exams but many reserved seats are empty because people leave bags on them.

title: Skills for first jobs
body: Graduates find that employers expect practical skills their degree courses did not teach.

title: Parents and school updates
body: Working parents miss notices, fee dates and homework updates sent on paper or in noisy chat groups.

title: Teaching in local languages
body: Children who study in their home language struggle to find good learning material in it.

title: Used textbooks
body: Students buy new textbooks every year while seniors' books in good condition go unsold.

title: Home cooks finding customers
body: Skilled home cooks want to sell meals to office workers nearby but have no simple way to take orders.

title: Food safety at street stalls
body: Customers like street food but worry about hygiene and have no way to tell which stalls are safe.

title: Farm prices for small farmers
body: Small farmers sell to middlemen at low prices because they cannot reach buyers in the city directly.

title: Canteen rush hour
body: Campus canteens have long queues at lunch, so students skip meals or arrive late to class.

title: Healthy snacks for children
body: Parents want healthy snacks for children but packaged options are full of sugar and salt.

title: Grocery for hostel students
body: Hostel students cannot easily buy fresh fruit and basic groceries without a long trip to the market.

title: Splitting shared expenses
body: Flatmates and trip groups argue over who owes what for rent, bills and shared purchases.

title: Credit for small shops
body: Neighbourhood shops cannot get small loans because they have no formal credit history.

title: Saving habits for students
body: Students spend their monthly allowance in two weeks and have nothing left for emergencies.

title: Fees in instalments
body: Families struggle to pay college fees in one lump sum at the start of the year.

title: Insurance for gig workers
body: Delivery riders and drivers have no health or accident cover and lose income when they are hurt.

title: Scam calls and messages
body: Older people lose savings to fake bank calls and messages they cannot tell apart from real ones.

title: Finding a PG near college
body: Students moving to a new city cannot trust online listings for paying-guest rooms and flats.

title: Maintenance requests
body: Tenants report broken fans and leaks to landlords who forget or delay repairs for weeks.

title: Roommate matching
body: Students sharing rooms with strangers face clashes over sleep, cleanliness and noise.

title: Security deposits
body: Tenants lose part of their deposit in disputes about damage when they move out.

title: Society notices and dues
body: Residents' associations collect dues and share notices through paper slips and missed messages.

title: Home repairs you can trust
body: Families cannot find a reliable electrician or plumber quickly and are overcharged in emergencies.

title: Local artisans online
body: Craftspeople sell beautiful handmade goods at local fairs but cannot reach buyers in other cities.

title: Returns for small sellers
body: Small online sellers lose money on returns they cannot inspect or resell.

title: Second-hand clothing
body: Good clothes are thrown away while many people would buy them second-hand if they trusted the quality.

title: Rural shop restocking
body: Village shopkeepers close for a day every week to travel to the wholesale market for stock.

title: Event merchandise
body: College clubs order event T-shirts and merchandise late and overpay for small batches.

title: Queue at the photocopy shop
body: Before exams, students wait an hour at the campus photocopy and print shop.

title: Power cuts for small businesses
body: Shops and clinics lose income during power cuts because generators are expensive to run.

title: Rooftop solar for homes
body: Families want rooftop solar but do not trust installers or understand the savings.

title: Electricity bills in hostels
body: Hostels pay large electricity bills because fans, lights and ACs are left on in empty rooms.

title: Cooking fuel in villages
body: Households in villages still cook on wood fires that fill homes with smoke.

title: EV charging points
body: Electric scooter owners worry about running out of charge because public charging points are rare.

title: Cold storage for farmers
body: Farmers lose fruit and vegetables after harvest because there is no affordable cold storage nearby.

title: Lost and found on campus
body: Students lose ID cards, keys and bottles on campus and rarely get them back.

title: Volunteering made easy
body: Students want to volunteer but do not know which local organisations need help and when.

title: Stray animal care
body: Neighbourhoods argue about stray animals that need feeding, vaccination and medical care.

title: Reporting broken streetlights
body: Broken streetlights and potholes are reported again and again but stay unfixed for months.

title: Senior citizens' loneliness
body: Older people in cities spend most days alone and have few chances to meet others.

title: Emergency contacts for travellers
body: Students travelling alone for internships have no quick way to alert family when something goes wrong.
